scene_1.text_1: Using a blower to smelt items takes a lot of space.
scene_1.text_2: Use a Magma Cube Belt instead.
scene_1.text_3: It automatically smelts items above it, taking the same amount of time as a blower.
scene_1.text_4: It does not have a blower's smelting protection, so remember to remove the item before it burns a second time!
scene_1.title: Magma Cube Belt
title: Magma Cube Belt
